entities.name: UAC-0006
entities.gloss: A financially motivated cybercriminal group tracking back to 2013 and known for targeting Ukrainian accounting departments.

entities.name: SMOKELOADER
entities.gloss: A modular bot and malware downloader used to deliver secondary payloads onto infected machines.

entities.name: LOADERX3
entities.gloss: A malware loader used to execute additional payloads and tools.

entities.name: RMS
entities.gloss: Remote Manipulator System, a legitimate remote desktop utility frequently abused by threat actors for unauthorized access.

entities.name: RDPWRAPPER
entities.gloss: An open-source utility that enables Remote Desktop Host support on Windows operating systems.

entities.name: DANABOT
entities.gloss: A modular banking Trojan and infostealer.

entities.name: LUMMASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information stealing malware designed to exfiltrate credentials and sensitive system data.

entities.name: REDLINESTEALER
entities.gloss: A widespread information stealer that collects browser credentials, crypto wallet data, and system information.

entities.name: SYSTEMBC
entities.gloss: A proxy malware and backdoor used to establish secure tunnels for command-and-control communication.

entities.name: TALESHOT
entities.gloss: A reconnaissance malware used to analyze active windows and processes and take screenshots.

entities.name: PIEJET
entities.gloss: A Python-based malware tool used by threat actors.

entities.name: LOADNEST
entities.gloss: A malware loader used to download and execute secondary malware payloads.

entities.name: HANGTHREAD
entities.gloss: A specialized denial-of-service malware designed to exhaust computer resources and freeze target machines.

entities.name: BACKSTAB
entities.gloss: A tool used to disable endpoint detection and antivirus software processes.

entities.name: AUKILL
entities.gloss: A defense-evasion tool used to disable endpoint protection products by abusing vulnerable drivers.

entities.name: Windows
entities.gloss: A family of proprietary operating systems developed by Microsoft.
